title: The two pullback identifications agree on the diagonal
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $c$ specify either a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in its fixed algebraic closure or the algebraic-closure coefficient, and put $\Lambda=(\operatorname{coefficient}\ell c).X$. Let $k$ be a field of prime characteristic $p\ne\ell$ and $Y$ any $k$-scheme. Use the coefficients, Tate lines and canonical comparison of [def-sfb-rational-p1-second-pull-comparison]. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_Y$, $q:P\to Y$, $W=P\times_Y P$, and write $p_1,p_2:W\to P$ and $\Delta:P\to W$ for the projections and diagonal. Use the ordinary unbounded internal-module derived categories and fixed functors of [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-pullback]. For arbitrary $K\in D_\Lambda(Y)$ set $M=q^*K(1)[2]$, and let $e_M:p_1^*M\simeq p_2^*M$ be secondPullComparison. Let $s_i:\Delta^*p_i^*\simeq\mathrm{Id}$ be the canonical pullSectionIso for $\Delta p_i=\mathrm{id}_P$. Then, writing semicolons in application order, $$\Delta^*(e_M^{-1});s_{1,M}=s_{2,M}.$$ This equality has no projection map, supported coefficient source, diagonal class, or trace. The Lean proposition [def-sfb-projective-pull-section-compatibility] has exactly this equation as its single field.

source.place: Second identity, cancellation on the diagonal before integration.

proof.text: Use residueIsUnit with the structural maps from the projective line and its self-product to Spec(k), obtaining invertibility of ell in every residue field. These are precisely the local instances required by the Tate transport data and the comparison expansion.

Obtain the already stated transport data for the two pull-twist comparisons. Apply the proved generic pull_section_transport calculation to these data and to the comm field of the untwisted section compatibility. This gives the restricted equation for the expanded comparison.

Rewrite the diagonal pullback of the canonical inverse comparison using second_pull_comparison_inv_map_expansion. The transported equation is exactly the single comm field of PullSectionCompatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem second_pull_section
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y)) :
    PullSectionCompatibility
      (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (firstProjection Y))
      (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (secondProjection Y))
      (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (diagonalImmersion Y))
      (pullSectionIso (coefficient l c).X Y (firstProjection Y)
        (by unfold firstProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_fst _))
      (pullSectionIso (coefficient l c).X Y (secondProjection Y)
        (by unfold secondProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_snd _))
      ((twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)
        (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K))
      (secondPullComparison l c k p hpl Y K).inv
